**Boss:** [Spellican](#loc=75367)

Note: Secret Portals are all super-powered versions of bosses from the game's plot. See the boss' map marker for strategies.
75344: Clear [Special Portal 1](#loc=75309) in Symphony of Sorcery as Sora.
75367:
**Weaknesses:** Zero Gravity, Magnet

You will have already encountered the Spellican a few times in Traverse Town by the time you fight it for real in Symphony of Sorcery. These encounters should have given you a glimpse at how Spellican's boss fight would go.

The boss fight starts with a chase; slide on the trail to follow after Spellican running away. The fight won't "properly" begin until you get close enough and hit Spellican with your Keyblade. 

Ranged attacks are a must if you plan on doing any meaningful damage against Spellican. They'll spend most of the fight teleporting away from Sora, often just as you're getting close to attack. Make sure to quickly dispatch any minions Spellican summons, as these small fry can waste time on your Drop Gauge if you're not careful.

Halfway through the fight, Spellican will run away and Sora will have to chase after him like at the beginning of the fight. Catch up to him again, and then repeat your strategy with ranged attacks to finally bring down Spellican.
